name.ja: SSH ターミナル (サンプル)

description.en: Sample third-party terminal backend: plain SSH to hosts you connect, with no cmux on the host.
description.ja: サードパーティのターミナルバックエンドのサンプル: 接続したホストへの通常の SSH。ホスト側に cmux は不要です。

connection.reason: Open a shell on the SSH hosts you pick. You accept each host key.

credential.reason: Sign in to those hosts with your SSH key. The app never sees the key.
